decisions.decision: Candidates return next week with a prepared presentation and follow-up questions; the Board will deliberate at the conclusion of that meeting, and may vote on an appointment, continue the process, or start over. The Board agreed.
decisions.quote: at the conclusion of that meeting we will deliberate. we can decide to vote on an appointment, decide to continue the process or we can decide to start the process over again. the board agreed.

budget_items.topic: Bond anticipation note for pavement management temporary financing
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A bond anticipation note of $800,000 due January 26, 2017 was presented for approval.
budget_items.quote: mr. toale stated this was a bond anticipation note (ban) in the amount of $800,000 due on january 26, 2017.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Finance Director Brochu said permanent borrowing of a larger amount in January 2017 would pay off the BAN and fund the spring paving.
budget_items.quote: finance director brochu confirmed and stated there will permanent borrowing on a larger amount ($2.5 million, which includes the $800,000) in january 2017

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Two Accounts Payable warrants were presented for signature.
budget_items.quote: he presented an accounts payable warrant in the amount of $1,202,514.55 and an accounts payable warrant in the amount of $582,687.39.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ms. Bertram noted additional costs of around $40,000 for the Summer Street project to move forward.
budget_items.quote: ms. bertram noted there will be additional costs of around $40,000 for the summer street project to move forward.

budget_items.topic: Property tax increases and Proposition 2 1/2 (candidate discussion)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Mr. Marciello explained that tax increases are limited under Proposition 2 1/2 and that assessments can also raise a bill.
budget_items.quote: people want to know why their taxes went up 4% when there is prop. 2 ½.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Mr. Marciello said he gave back a share of his pay to keep the Rehoboth budget balanced during the recession.
budget_items.quote: i gave back almost 10% of my pay to keep the budget balanced.
